cases.boundary: Run and outbox commit succeeds before Redis notification
cases.fault_injection: Redis unavailable after the database transaction commits
cases.expected_state: Run remains queued and outbox delivery is recoverable
invariants: one user message and one Run per idempotency key
notification retry does not duplicate execution
cases.retry_rule: bounded outbox retry only; never create a second Run

cases.boundary: Worker claim, attempt lease, and generation fencing
cases.fault_injection: Deliver one Run ID concurrently to two workers, then expire the first owner's lease
cases.expected_state: At most one current attempt owns the Run; stale owner cannot change current state
invariants: stale generation cannot append product output or terminal events
cases.retry_rule: recover only through a new fenced attempt after the old lease expires

cases.fault_injection: Make the isolated checkpoint store fail during a write and then recover
cases.expected_state: Current attempt fails with a stable checkpoint error and no product success is committed
invariants: checkpoint failure is not reported as success
a later attempt cannot read another tenant or attempt checkpoint
cases.retry_rule: no blind replay of a tool call whose side-effect state is unknown

cases.boundary: Atomic assistant message, checkpoint pointer, and Run terminal commit
cases.fault_injection: Fail product-state serialization/write after model execution returns
cases.expected_state: Run is not completed and no partial assistant message is visible
invariants: message and terminal state commit atomically
failed commit emits no run.completed event
cases.retry_rule: recovery must inspect committed product facts before any new execution

cases.boundary: SSE event delivery and cursor-based reconnect
cases.fault_injection: Disconnect after a persisted text event, reconnect from its last event ID
cases.expected_state: Only later ordered events are replayed and the stream does not change Run state
invariants: event IDs remain ordered and unique
reconnect does not regenerate the answer or tool effects
cases.retry_rule: resume reads persisted events from the supplied cursor; it does not resubmit the message

cases.boundary: Current principal, Agent grant, resource ACL, or tool authorization recheck before commit
cases.fault_injection: Revoke the synthetic user's required grant while model execution is blocked, then release it
cases.expected_state: The worker stops or fails closed and does not commit an unauthorized answer or action
invariants: authorization is checked against current database state
no stale grant authorizes a later side effect
cases.retry_rule: no automatic retry under the revoked scope

cases.boundary: One-time approval consumption and release of a waiting Run
cases.fault_injection: Interrupt delivery after an approval is consumed but before the resumed Run is claimed
cases.expected_state: Approval consumption remains unique and the waiting Run is either recoverable or explicitly blocked
invariants: resume does not bypass current authorization or frozen action parameters
cases.retry_rule: resume from persisted approval and Run state; never issue a second business action from delivery retry

cases.boundary: External target commit followed by lost response before local receipt persistence
cases.fault_injection: Synthetic target commits once and drops the response; recovery queries by the original business key
cases.expected_state: Action remains unknown until independently verified; duplicate target effects are absent
invariants: unknown is not success or not-executed
same-key retry requires proof the old request cannot still commit
cases.retry_rule: reconcile first; do not resend while target outcome is unknown
